promptSets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: Forest Heart game character animation sprite sheet, exactly TWO equal portrait cells side by side, no gutters, canvas aspect ratio 4:3. Both frames show the exact reference pose and framing from crown to mid thigh, with relaxed right arm down. LEFT cell: calm alert idle, green eyes fully open, relaxed lips. RIGHT cell: EXACT COPY OF LEFT cell, ONLY eyelids gently CLOSED for one natural blink, no head movement, absolutely no change of mouth, hands, clothes, hair, scale or lighting. Crucial registration: both characters centered identically within their respective cells, same crown height, eye line, shoulders, waist, hem; exact equal cell dimensions, no overlap across cell border. Match the detailed realistic painted fantasy game art of the supplied image. Leave comfortable transparent margin around hair and hands. Genuine alpha transparency everywhere behind character; no black, gray or checkerboard painted background. Keep the supplied face and costume faithfully. No new props, no additional characters, no scenery, no lettering, no borders, no watermark. The two frames must overlay cleanly for blinking. Target full sheet 1600x1200 or larger at the same 4:3 aspect.

Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: THREE-FRAME character pose atlas for Forest Heart game. Input image 1 is the same adult elf woman to preserve, including her exact face, long silver hair with lavender rimlight, green eyes, pointed ears, purple skirt, emerald leaf corset, gold leaf filigree and jewelry. Create ONE transparent sprite sheet with exactly THREE equal portrait cells side by side, NO gutters or borders, overall aspect ratio 2:1, target 2400x1200. Each cell is a full portrait from crown to mid thigh. Same camera, scale, body position and lighting as input. Common registration in every cell: crown at y=2% of cell, eyes at y=16%, neck at y=25%, waist at y=55%, hip at y=70%; face center x=45% within its cell, torso center x=50%. Her head and hips should remain nearly stationary across poses. Keep left hand holding the same emerald crystal near her left hip (screen right) in ALL poses. LEFT FRAME, CHOICE: turn eyes and chin slightly toward screen left where the board sits, extend her free right arm down-left in a graceful inviting gesture, index and middle finger subtly indicate a choice, attentive neutral expression, no reward. MIDDLE FRAME, CHANNEL ENERGY: right forearm lifts toward screen left with palm forward, focused green-eyed look at the board, slim mint energy ribbon softly curls around her open palm, no big flash, powerful controlled magic. RIGHT FRAME, FLOWER: her right hand cups a small luminous gold forest blossom at chest level toward screen left, soft pleased smile and gaze toward the blossom; this is a small intermediate acknowledgement. Distinct hand silhouettes, anatomically correct hands with five fingers, no extra limbs, no staff, no text, no coins, no scenery. Rich realistic painted high-end fantasy game character art matching input, same identity, same costume and coverage, genuine clean alpha transparency behind every figure. All three figures must stay inside their own equal cell with safe margin around hands and hair; do not overlap cells. This is a production sprite sheet, not a UI mockup. No labels, no watermark.

No extra limbs, no anatomy distortion, no staff, no extra characters, no text, no border, no background, no watermark. Genuine alpha transparent outside each figure and between hair strands. Production character sheet, no UI.
